class_to_concept_matrix._description: Soft per-class concept profile (7 classes x 10 concepts), values in [0,1]. Per-image targets aggregate active classes via MAX-DEVIATION-FROM-NORMAL: for each concept, pick the active classs value whose signed deviation from the Normal row is largest in absolute value. Preserves defining-abnormality signals on multi-label cells.

concept_constraint_matrix._description: Symmetric 10x10 matrix, values in [-1, +1]. Diagonal = 1.0. From Morphological_Concepts.docx §6. The docx defines no -1 entries; the ConstraintModule therefore uses a SOFT cooccur loss -<C, mean p p^T>_F (off-diagonal) rather than hard mutex penalties. The R-matching loss ||R R^T - C||_F^2 is also active. Constrained vs unconstrained ablation = lambda>0 vs lambda=0. NOTE: cytoplasmic_vacuolization_degree was removed (10 concepts, formerly 11) as non-biological for the GR-Neutro neutrophil corpus -- the morphometry detector fired on artefacts (~85% of cells, mean 0.69), not real vacuoles, so its signed AUC 0.634 reliability was spurious; the toxic-change-triad cooccurrence priors that paired vacuoles with Döhle/toxic granulation and the Hypergranulation.vacuolization entry were dropped with it.

negative_associated_pairs.reason: Increased basophilia reflects reactive, non-uniform cytoplasm (docx §6.1)
Increased segmentation reduces apparent nuclear compactness (docx §6.1)

cooccurring_pairs.reason: Dense chromatin is typically coarse and clumped (docx §6.2)
Chromatin condensation associated with compact nuclear appearance (docx §6.2)
Increased segmentation leads to more irregular nuclear contours (docx §6.2)
Increased granule number associated with increased granule prominence (docx §6.2)

edits_applied_vs_docx.v2_2026-05-06: Dohle.basophilia 0.4->0.6 / Hypergran.vacuolization 0.4->0.6 / Dohle.vacuolization 0.3->0.5. Reason: at hard threshold 0.5 the v1 values left basophilia and vacuolization with zero positive support, capping mean concept F1 at 9/11=0.82. Bumped to clinically-defensible levels (toxic-change neutrophils do have generalized basophilia/visible vacuoles).
edits_applied_vs_docx.v3_2026-06-09: Removed cytoplasmic_vacuolization_degree concept (11 -> 10 concepts). Reason: non-biological for the in-house GR-Neutro neutrophil corpus -- cytoplasmic vacuolization does not occur in this corpus; the morphometry detector fired on artefacts in ~85% of cells (mean 0.69) rather than real vacuoles, making its signed AUC 0.634 reliability spurious. Dropped its class_to_concept_matrix column, its constraint-matrix row/column, and the toxic-change-triad / Hypergranulation cooccurrence priors that referenced it. This reduces the textbook-CBM bottleneck dimension from 11 to 10 for FUTURE runs.
